title: Intuitive Machines, Inc. August 3, 2026 Form 8-K
excerpt: The UK consideration was GBP 37.0 million, split equally between cash and 960,649 Class A shares; COMSAT had a USD 10 million base cash price plus expenses and adjustments.
summary: The unchanged August 3 Form 8-K confirms completion of the Goonhilly UK and U.S. acquisitions and identifies the known cash, share issuance, expense and post-closing adjustment terms, but provides no acquired financial contribution or integration-cost forecast.
